design_philosophy: COHEIR™ is a premium professional operating system. The design must feel like a Grammy-caliber press kit. It uses an Obsidian interface with cinematic lighting, premium glassmorphism, and Apple-quality micro-interactions. The aesthetic is elite, verified, and deeply professional.

forbidden: Flat, untextured pure grays without blue/orange tint

scale.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none font-heading

surfaces_and_glassmorphism.premium_glass: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-2xl
surfaces_and_glassmorphism.interactive_glass: bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.06] backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/[0.05] hover:border-white/[0.15] transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl

mentor_card.layout: Flex column or horizontal row. Must use interactive_glass container.
mentor_card.elements: Avatar with electric blue gradient ring, JetBrains Mono role chip, Verified Checkmark (Electric Blue), Cabinet Grotesk name, credit line, disciplines, location pin.
mentor_card.cta: Outlined pill button 'View Profile' or 'Request Mentorship'

role_chip.style: bg-white/[0.05] border border-white/[0.1] text-xs font-mono text-zinc-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full inline-flex items-center

verified_badge.usage: Always placed immediately to the right of the professional's name.

stat_row.layout: Grid cols-2 md:cols-4 gap-4, using premium_glass container for each item with generous p-6 padding.
stat_row.elements: Large glowing numbers (Cabinet Grotesk text-3xl), tiny mono labels (JetBrains Mono text-xs) below.

buttons.primary_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F0FF] via-[#8B5CF6] to-[#F97316] text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(139,92,246,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary_outline: bg-transparent border border-white/[0.2] text-white hover:bg-white/[0.05] rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-all

app_shell.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, pure black (#000) or ultra-dark obsidian. Contains ecosystem nav (Home, ANCRA, ANCRLAB, ANCRSync, COHEIR active, ANCRLaunch, Passport, AIAH, Calendar, Conversations, Library, ANCRID, Settings).
app_shell.header: Sticky top, heavy_glass z-50. Contains search command bar (⌘K), notifications, messages, user profile.

professional_profile_flagship.description: Centerpiece of COHEIR. Feels like a Grammy-caliber press kit.
professional_profile_flagship.hero: Cinematic wide hero image max-h-[40vh], max overlay black/50, glowing gradient accents.
professional_profile_flagship.header_section: Avatar, Name + Verified Badge, Role chips, 'Request Mentorship' primary CTA. Negative margin to overlap hero.
professional_profile_flagship.body: Bento grid layout for Credits, Awards, Mentoring Philosophy, Portfolio, Availability.

dashboard.layout: Bento grid protocol (Tetris or High Density). Generous internal card padding (p-6 or p-8).
dashboard.sections: Stat row, Upcoming Sessions, Assigned Students, Creative Alerts, Industry Meetings.

motion_and_interaction.cinematic_reveals: Staggered fade-up animations on load (using framer-motion variants).
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Soft scale (scale-105 for images, scale-[1.02] for cards). Border glow intensifies on hover.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Apple-quality fluid transitions. transition-all duration-300 ease-out.

data_testid_conventions.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text against obsidian backgrounds meets minimum APCA/WCAG ratios. Use text-white for primary, text-zinc-400 for secondary.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use Tailwind CSS for all styling.

DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. You MUST use Cabinet Grotesk (headings), Satoshi (body), and JetBrains Mono (labels/code). IMPORTANT: Import them in index.css from Fontshare and Google Fonts (@import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@900,800,700,500,400&f[]=satoshi@900,700,500,400&display=swap'); @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');).
Implement the layout using a fixed left sidebar and a sticky top header.
The Professional Profile must be built as a flagship page with a cinematic hero, verified badge, and bento grid for credits/awards.
Ensure all glassmorphism uses backdrop-blur-xl and subtle white/opacity borders.
DO NOT use any pure white backgrounds or light mode themes. The entire app is locked to the Obsidian theme.
Apply Framer Motion for staggered list reveals and hover interactions.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for UI iconography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use default generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform, or colors.
Do not center-align the app container. Text reading flow must remain natural (left-aligned).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Generous padding creates a premium feel.
Use the provided image URLs to prevent the use of placeholders.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Do not rely on inheritance.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds in sticky headers; use heavy glassmorphism instead.
